page.layout: One block of text, single column, centred on the page top; a signature in italic script below it; then the word FINIS centred. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at lower right (omitted).

main_text.p: dem præsentium transsumptis, etiam impressis, manu Notarii publici subscriptis, & Sigillo personæ in dignitate Ecclesiastica constitutæ munitis, eadem prorsus fides ubique locorum & gentium in Iudiciis, & extra illud adhiberetur, quæ ipsis præsentibus adhiberetur, si forent exhibitæ, vel ostensæ. Datum Romæ apud Sanctam Mariam majorem sub annulo Piscatoris die 26.Novembr. & solenniter ibidem publicatum 3.Ianuar. Anno M. DC. LI. Pontificatus Nostri octavo.

page.notes: The first line reads "[8.]" as a printed page number at the head. The signature "M.A.Maraldus." is in a cursive italic hand, rendered here as printed. Long s rendered as s throughout. The printed lines "dem præsentium transsumptis" and "ibidem publicatum" are as printed; "ostensæ" and "exhibitæ" as printed. The phrase "quæ ipsis præsentibus adhiberetur" is as printed and may be a printer's error for "adhiberetur" repetition; left unchanged.
